messages:
sami-fin: FYI invoice 91234 from BetaCorp applied a $9,000 promotional credit against their $60k prepaid annual commit. Promo effective 2026-04-15 per amendment. How do we treat for April close? defer vs immediate?

raj-rev: Under our ASC 606 policy, discounts tied to future performance are allocated across remaining performance obligations. Remaining months = Apr–Dec = 9 months (promo effective mid-April).

claire-sales: Signed amendment dated 2026-04-10, customer requested promo start 4/15. Billing showed net cash received.

sami-fin: two questions: do we prorate April because promo starts 4/15? and what JE to post for month-close?

raj-rev: Materiality threshold: monthly impact = 1,000 if spread over 9 months. It's below our $5k proration threshold, so we treat April as full-month amortization. Proposed entries:

Dr Unearned Revenue 9,000
  Cr Contract Liability - Promo 9,000  (initial allocation)

Monthly amort (from May onward):
Dr Contract Liability - Promo 1,000
  Cr Revenue 1,000

For April since we treat as full-month: post one month of amort = 1,000 recognized in April. Document judgment in close pack.

tax-ops: note: invoice taxed on net. We'll check VAT/SalesTax consequences; likely no retro tax filings for immaterial amounts but will confirm.

close-bot: Revenue schedule update queued for invoice/91234. Tag RS-BETACORP-91234-PROMO.

claire-sales: please attach signed amendment to monthclose pack so audit can trace.

sami-fin: will do. I'll upload JE and amort schedule to monthclose/2026-04 and tag finance-lead for signoff. Closing after approval.

raj-rev: ack, will review JE after tax confirms.
